re_confirm_body: This is the exact command that will run. Check paths before continuing.
re_files_note: Commands run in the built-in terminal. Files must be inside its environment, by default /workspace/re (for example: wget -O /workspace/re/app.apk <URL>). Phone storage is not visible from inside the sandbox.
re_frida_termux_note: Frida needs root on the real device, so it cannot run inside the built-in environment. These buttons still use Termux (optional).
re_intro: Every action runs in the built-in terminal only after you read the exact command and confirm it. Use these tools on apps you own or are authorized to analyze.
re_pass_note: The password appears in the command and in the terminal history. Use a throwaway password for a local test keystore.
re_root_warning: Frida server needs root on the device. Without root, this step will fail.
re_storage_note: For the Frida buttons only: run the storage setup once so Termux can read Download/HeraclesRE.

terminal_note: Built-in terminal (PRoot + Alpine). It runs inside the app and does not need Termux. Commands are not interactive: you cannot type input after a command starts, and there is no stop button, so a command ends only when it finishes or times out (10 minutes).

termux_external_apps_hint: In Termux, add allow-external-apps = true to ~/.termux/termux.properties, then restart Termux. This app cannot change that setting for you.
termux_intro: Engineering tools run inside Termux. Install Termux from F-Droid first (the Play Store version is outdated and cannot be used here).
termux_permission_hint: Grant the permission in Android Settings: Apps > Sellaoui Engineering AI > Permissions > Run commands in Termux environment.

workspace_explainer: A workspace is the project folder the agent will work in.
